WITH batsman_over AS (
  SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, SUM("runs_scored") as total_batsman_runs
  FROM batsman_scored
  GROUP BY match_id, over_id, innings_no
),
extra_over AS (
  SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, SUM("extra_runs") as total_extra_runs
  FROM extra_runs
  GROUP BY match_id, over_id, innings_no
),
combined_over AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(b.match_id, e.match_id) as match_id,
         COALESCE(b.over_id, e.over_id) as over_id,
         COALESCE(b.innings_no, e.innings_no) as innings_no,
         COALESCE(b.total_batsman_runs, 0) + COALESCE(e.total_extra_runs, 0) as total_over_runs
  FROM batsman_over b
  FULL OUTER JOIN extra_over e 
    ON b.match_id = e.match_id 
    AND b.over_id = e.over_id 
    AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
),
ranked_over AS (
  SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, total_over_runs,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_over_runs DESC, over_id ASC, innings_no ASC) as rn
  FROM combined_over
),
best_over AS (
  SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, total_over_runs
  FROM ranked_over
  WHERE rn = 1
),
bowler_counts AS (
  SELECT bo.match_id, bo.over_id, bo.innings_no, bo.total_over_runs,
         bbb.bowler,
         COUNT(*) as ball_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bo.match_id, bo.over_id, bo.innings_no ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, bbb.bowler ASC) as rn
  FROM best_over bo
  JOIN ball_by_ball bbb 
    ON bo.match_id = bbb.match_id 
    AND bo.over_id = bbb.over_id 
    AND bo.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
  GROUP BY bo.match_id, bo.over_id, bo.innings_no, bo.total_over_runs, bbb.bowler
),
chosen_bowler AS (
  SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, total_over_runs, bowler
  FROM bowler_counts
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, total_over_runs, bowler
FROM chosen_bowler
ORDER BY match_id
LIMIT 20
